description:
Check content for prompt injection (inbound) or leaked secrets and personal data (outbound) before an
agent acts on it or sends it. Returns allow / warn / block, the findings, a redacted copy for outbound
secrets, and an Ed25519-signed receipt anchored on-chain, which proves the check happened. Privi does
not store the text. Free for 1,000 checks a month with an organization key; otherwise 1 cent per check
in USDC via x402.

direction.description: inbound = untrusted content coming in (prompt injection, hidden instructions); outbound = content going out (API keys, card numbers, data smuggled in URLs)
direction.title: Direction

source.description: Optional label for the receipt, e.g. the page URL or tool name
source.title: Source

text.description: The content to check: a web page, email, document or tool result the agent is about to act on (inbound), or what the agent is about to send (outbound)
text.title: Text
